page.overview:
Who is Ilka?

Ilka was the fourth concubine Nivellen shared his home with.

She came to Nivellen shortly after Primula. Like the two before her, Ilka was first afraid of him but then, after receiving good treatment and gifts, became aroused. After a year, she left rich and with tender farewells.
